package syscall_test

import (
	"internal/gomadvfd"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"unsafe"
)

type gomadPointerBackend struct {
	bytes        [8]byte
	count        int
	limit        int
	remoteStatus gomadvfd.Status
}

func (*gomadPointerBackend) Socket() (any, gomadvfd.Status)                { return 1, gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Attach(any, uintptr, uint64)                   {}
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Bind(any, gomadvfd.Address) gomadvfd.Status    { return gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Listen(any, int) gomadvfd.Status               { return gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Connect(any, gomadvfd.Address) gomadvfd.Status { return gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Accept(any) (any, gomadvfd.Address, gomadvfd.Status) {
	return 2, gomadvfd.Address{IP: [4]byte{127, 7, 8, 9}, Port: 0x2345}, gomadvfd.OK
}
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Shutdown(any, int) gomadvfd.Status { return gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Close(any) gomadvfd.Status         { return gomadvfd.OK }
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Local(any) (gomadvfd.Address, gomadvfd.Status) {
	return gomadvfd.Address{IP: [4]byte{127, 1, 2, 3}, Port: 0x1234}, gomadvfd.OK
}
func (backend *gomadPointerBackend) Remote(any) (gomadvfd.Address, gomadvfd.Status) {
	return gomadvfd.Address{IP: [4]byte{127, 4, 5, 6}, Port: 0x5678}, backend.remoteStatus
}
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Refuse(string) {}
func (*gomadPointerBackend) Read(_ any, p []byte) (int, gomadvfd.Status) {
	return copy(p, "abcdefgh"), gomadvfd.OK
}
func (backend *gomadPointerBackend) Write(_ any, p []byte) (int, gomadvfd.Status) {
	n := len(p)
	if backend.limit != 0 {
		n = min(n, backend.limit)
	}
	backend.count = copy(backend.bytes[:], p[:n])
	return n, gomadvfd.OK
}

func TestGomadVFDPointerFixture(t *testing.T) {
	selection := os.Getenv("GOMAD_VFD_POINTER_CASE")
	if selection == "" {
		t.Fatal("GOMAD_VFD_POINTER_CASE must select one disposable-process fixture")
	}
	if selection == "no-growth" {
		selection += "/0"
	}
	operation, variantText, ok := strings.Cut(selection, "/")
	variant, err := strconv.Atoi(variantText)
	if !ok || err != nil || variant < 0 || variant >= syscall.GomadPointerVariants {
		t.Fatalf("invalid pointer fixture selection %q", selection)
	}
	switch operation {
	case "writev-partial", "writev-full", "no-growth", "accept", "accept-null", "accept-mismatch", "sockname", "sockname-short", "peername", "peername-short":
	case "option-type", "option-error", "option-short":
		if variant%2 != 1 {
			t.Fatal("getsockopt requires a six-argument route")
		}
	default:
		t.Fatalf("unknown pointer fixture %q", operation)
	}
	backend := &gomadPointerBackend{}
	if status := gomadvfd.RegisterBackend(backend); status != gomadvfd.OK {
		t.Fatal(status)
	}
	if status := gomadvfd.SetEnabled(true, nil); status != gomadvfd.OK {
		t.Fatal(status)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if status := gomadvfd.SetEnabled(false, nil); status != gomadvfd.OK {
			t.Errorf("disable boundary: %v", status)
		}
		syscall.GomadPointerReset(false, false)
	})
	fd, status := gomadvfd.Socket()
	if status != gomadvfd.OK {
		t.Fatal(status)
	}
	gomadPointerClose(t, fd)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		switch operation {
		case "writev-partial", "writev-full", "no-growth":
			gomadPointerWritevFixture(t, backend, fd, operation, variant)
		case "accept-null", "accept-mismatch":
			gomadPointerAcceptValidation(t, fd, operation, variant)
		case "accept", "sockname", "sockname-short", "peername", "peername-short":
			gomadPointerPairFixture(t, fd, operation, variant)
		case "option-type", "option-error", "option-short":
			gomadPointerOptionFixture(t, backend, fd, operation, variant)
		}
	}()
	<-done
}

func gomadPointerClose(t *testing.T, fd int) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if status := gomadvfd.Close(fd); status != gomadvfd.OK {
			t.Errorf("close descriptor %d: %v", fd, status)
		}
	})
}

func gomadPointerMoved(observation syscall.GomadPointerObservation, before, current [3]uintptr, count int) bool {
	if observation.Calls != 1 || observation.Entry[0] != before[0] {
		return false
	}
	if count == 2 && observation.Entry[1] != before[1] {
		return false
	}
	for i := range count {
		if before[i] == 0 || before[i] == observation.After[i] || observation.After[i] != current[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerWritevFixture(t *testing.T, backend *gomadPointerBackend, fd int, operation string, variant int) {
	a, b := [6]byte{0x5a, 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 0xa5}, [6]byte{0x3c, 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h', 0xc3}
	vectors := struct {
		before uint64
		data   [2]syscall.Iovec
		after  uint64
	}{before: 0x123456789abcdef0, data: [2]syscall.Iovec{{Base: &a[1], Len: 4}, {Base: &b[1], Len: 4}}, after: 0xfedcba9876543210}
	backend.limit = 0
	wantCount, wantBytes := uintptr(8), "abcdefgh"
	if operation == "writev-partial" {
		backend.limit = 6
		wantCount, wantBytes = 6, "abcdef"
	}
	syscall.GomadPointerReset(true, operation == "no-growth")
	before := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&vectors.data[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&a[1])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[1]))}
	n, errno := syscall.GomadPointerWritev(fd, &vectors.data[0], variant)
	current := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&vectors.data[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&a[1])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[1]))}
	observation := syscall.GomadPointerSnapshot()
	if operation == "no-growth" {
		if observation.Calls != 1 || observation.Entry[0] != observation.After[0] || observation.After != current || gomadPointerMoved(observation, observation.After, current, 3) {
			t.Fatal("no-growth writev control did not reject unchanged entry memory")
		}
	} else if !gomadPointerMoved(observation, before, current, 3) {
		t.Fatalf("writev array/payload relocation inconclusive: before=%x entry=%x after=%x current=%x calls=%d", before, observation.Entry, observation.After, current, observation.Calls)
	}
	if vectors.data[0].Base != &a[1] || vectors.data[1].Base != &b[1] || vectors.data[0].Len != 4 || vectors.data[1].Len != 4 {
		t.Fatal("relocated iovec roots or lengths corrupted")
	}
	if n != wantCount || errno != 0 || backend.count != int(wantCount) || string(backend.bytes[:backend.count]) != wantBytes {
		t.Fatalf("writev result: n=%d errno=%v count=%d bytes=%q", n, errno, backend.count, backend.bytes[:backend.count])
	}
	if a != [6]byte{0x5a, 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 0xa5} || b != [6]byte{0x3c, 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h', 0xc3} || vectors.before != 0x123456789abcdef0 || vectors.after != 0xfedcba9876543210 {
		t.Fatal("writev payload or adjacent sentinels corrupted")
	}
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerPairFixture(t *testing.T, fd int, operation string, variant int) {
	output := struct {
		before uint64
		raw    syscall.RawSockaddrAny
		after  uint64
	}{before: 0x123456789abcdef0, after: 0xfedcba9876543210}
	length := struct{ before, value, after uint32 }{0x12345678, uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(output.raw)), 0x87654321}
	for i := range unsafe.Sizeof(output.raw) {
		unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&output.raw)), int(unsafe.Sizeof(output.raw)))[i] = 0xcc
	}
	short := strings.HasSuffix(operation, "-short")
	if short {
		length.value = 6
	}
	syscall.GomadPointerReset(true, false)
	before := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&output.raw)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&length.value))}
	n, errno := syscall.GomadPointerPair(fd, &output.raw, &length.value, operation, variant)
	current := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&output.raw)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&length.value))}
	observation := syscall.GomadPointerSnapshot()
	if operation == "accept" && errno == 0 {
		gomadPointerClose(t, int(n))
	}
	if !gomadPointerMoved(observation, before, current, 2) {
		t.Fatalf("sockaddr/length relocation inconclusive: before=%x entry=%x after=%x current=%x calls=%d", before, observation.Entry, observation.After, current, observation.Calls)
	}
	if errno != 0 || length.value != 16 || operation != "accept" && n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("address result: n=%d errno=%v length=%d", n, errno, length.value)
	}
	if operation == "accept" && (int(n) == fd || !gomadvfd.Owns(int(n))) {
		t.Fatal("accept did not produce a distinct live descriptor")
	}
	want := [16]byte{2, 0, 0x12, 0x34, 127, 1, 2, 3}
	if strings.HasPrefix(operation, "peername") {
		want = [16]byte{2, 0, 0x56, 0x78, 127, 4, 5, 6}
	} else if operation == "accept" {
		want = [16]byte{2, 0, 0x23, 0x45, 127, 7, 8, 9}
	}
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		want[0], want[1] = 16, 2
	}
	copied := 16
	if short {
		copied = 6
	}
	bytes := unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&output.raw)), int(unsafe.Sizeof(output.raw)))
	for i, value := range bytes {
		expected := byte(0xcc)
		if i < copied {
			expected = want[i]
		}
		if value != expected {
			t.Fatalf("address byte %d=%x want=%x", i, value, expected)
		}
	}
	if output.before != 0x123456789abcdef0 || output.after != 0xfedcba9876543210 || length.before != 0x12345678 || length.after != 0x87654321 {
		t.Fatal("sockaddr/length adjacent sentinels corrupted")
	}
	if !short {
		address, err := syscall.GomadPointerSockaddr(&output.raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		inet, ok := address.(*syscall.SockaddrInet4)
		wantPort, wantIP := 0x1234, [4]byte{127, 1, 2, 3}
		if strings.HasPrefix(operation, "peername") {
			wantPort, wantIP = 0x5678, [4]byte{127, 4, 5, 6}
		} else if operation == "accept" {
			wantPort, wantIP = 0x2345, [4]byte{127, 7, 8, 9}
		}
		if !ok || inet.Port != wantPort || inet.Addr != wantIP {
			t.Fatalf("decoded address=%v want port=%d IP=%v", address, wantPort, wantIP)
		}
	}
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerOptionFixture(t *testing.T, backend *gomadPointerBackend, fd int, operation string, variant int) {
	output := struct {
		before uint32
		value  int32
		after  uint32
	}{0x12345678, -99, 0x87654321}
	length := struct{ before, value, after uint32 }{0x13579bdf, 4, 0xfdb97531}
	name, wantValue, wantErrno := syscall.SO_TYPE, int32(syscall.SOCK_STREAM), syscall.Errno(0)
	if operation == "option-error" {
		name, wantValue = syscall.SO_ERROR, int32(syscall.ECONNRESET)
		backend.remoteStatus = gomadvfd.Reset
	} else if operation == "option-short" {
		length.value, wantValue, wantErrno = 3, -99, syscall.EINVAL
	}
	syscall.GomadPointerReset(true, false)
	before := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&output.value)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&length.value))}
	n, errno := syscall.GomadPointerOption(fd, name, &output.value, &length.value, variant)
	current := [3]uintptr{uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&output.value)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&length.value))}
	observation := syscall.GomadPointerSnapshot()
	if !gomadPointerMoved(observation, before, current, 2) {
		t.Fatalf("option/length relocation inconclusive: before=%x entry=%x after=%x current=%x calls=%d", before, observation.Entry, observation.After, current, observation.Calls)
	}
	wantLength := uint32(4)
	if operation == "option-short" {
		wantLength = 3
	}
	if errno != wantErrno || output.value != wantValue || length.value != wantLength || errno == 0 && n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("option result: n=%d errno=%v value=%d length=%d", n, errno, output.value, length.value)
	}
	if output.before != 0x12345678 || output.after != 0x87654321 || length.before != 0x13579bdf || length.after != 0xfdb97531 {
		t.Fatal("option/length adjacent sentinels corrupted")
	}
}

//go:noinline
func gomadPointerAcceptValidation(t *testing.T, fd int, operation string, variant int) {
	syscall.GomadPointerReset(false, false)
	if operation == "accept-null" {
		n, errno := syscall.GomadPointerPair(fd, nil, nil, operation, variant)
		if errno == 0 {
			gomadPointerClose(t, int(n))
		}
		if errno != 0 || int(n) == fd || !gomadvfd.Owns(int(n)) {
			t.Fatalf("null/null accept: n=%d errno=%v", n, errno)
		}
		return
	}
	var raw syscall.RawSockaddrAny
	for i := range unsafe.Sizeof(raw) {
		unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&raw)), int(unsafe.Sizeof(raw)))[i] = 0xcc
	}
	n, errno := syscall.GomadPointerPair(fd, &raw, nil, operation, variant)
	if errno != syscall.EFAULT || n != ^uintptr(0) {
		t.Fatalf("missing accept length: n=%d errno=%v", n, errno)
	}
	for _, value := range unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&raw)), int(unsafe.Sizeof(raw))) {
		if value != 0xcc {
			t.Fatal("mismatched accept changed output bytes")
		}
	}
	length := uint32(16)
	n, errno = syscall.GomadPointerPair(fd, nil, &length, operation, variant)
	if errno != syscall.EFAULT || n != ^uintptr(0) || length != 16 {
		t.Fatalf("missing accept address: n=%d errno=%v length=%d", n, errno, length)
	}
}
